newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas softens on weather, maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas softens on weather, maintenance.

text.p: Canadian spot natgas prices extended their losses Monday as above-normal temperatures put a damper on demand and scheduled spring maintenance allowed no gas to move through the Empress border, industry sources said.

Spot gas at the AECO storage hub was quoted mostly at C$1.64-1.67 per gigajoule (GJ), down about 10 cents, as traders blamed the price softening on extensive maintenance at Empress, which backed some gas back into Alberta.
Temperatures in Calgary were forecast to reach 75 degrees Fahrenheit today, with a high of 80 degrees expected on Wednesday, Weather Services Corp said.
